by
  let f := fun x => Φ ↑x
  let g := fun x => Φ ↑x
  have h : ∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → f n = g n := by intro n hn; refl
  rw [LSeriesSummable_congr f g s h]
  apply LSeriesSummable_of_isBigO_rpow s
  let x := s.re - 1 / 2
  have hx : x < s.re := by norm_num
  have hbigo : f =O[Filter.atTop] fun n => ↑n ^ (x - 1) :=
    by
      let g := fun n => Φ ↑n
      let N := Nat.posOfNeZero N
      let φ := Φ
      let p := N
      let f' := fun n => φ (n % p)
      have h_periodic : ∀ n, f n = f' n := by intro n; rfl
      have h_bigO : f' =O[Filter.atTop] fun n => ↑n ^ (x - 1) :=
        by
          let c := Complex.abs φ 0
          let d := Complex.abs φ 1
          let e := Complex.abs φ 2
          let m := max c d e
          have h_bound : ∀ n, |f' n| ≤ m * ↑n ^ (x - 1) :=
            by intro n; cases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with h0 hp; simp [h0]; exact
              calc |φ (n % p)| ≤ max c d e by simp
              ... ≤ m * ↑n ^ (x - 1) by simp
          apply BigO.bigO_le_const m
          apply BigO.eventually_le Filter.atTop
          intro n
          exact h_bound n
      apply BigO.trans h_bigO h_periodic
  exact hbigo
  exact hx
